payload.title: Reading LiPD formatted datasets with `PyLiPD`
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of the `PyLiPD` Python package for handling LiPD formatted datasets. It covers loading datasets from local files, URLs, directories, and a remote graph database. The notebook also illustrates how to load datasets in parallel and merge multiple LiPD objects. The primary focus is on reading and manipulating paleoclimate data using object-oriented programming.

steps.description: Introduction to the `PyLiPD` package, which facilitates reading, manipulating, and writing LiPD formatted datasets.
steps.title: Introduction to PyLiPD

steps.description: Create an empty LiPD object and load a dataset from a local file. Display the dataset names contained in the object.
steps.title: Loading LiPD formatted datasets from a local file

steps.description: Load a LiPD dataset from a URL into a new LiPD object and display the dataset names. Also, load the dataset into an existing object.
steps.title: Loading a LiPD formatted dataset from a URL

steps.description: Load datasets from a directory into a LiPD object and display the dataset names. Append additional datasets to the object.
steps.title: Loading from a directory

steps.description: Load datasets from the remote LipdGraph database using SPARQL queries and display the dataset names.
steps.title: Loading from the remote LipdGraph database

steps.description: Load multiple LiPD files in parallel using the `if __name__ == "__main__"` notation and display the dataset names.
steps.title: Loading in parallel
